hypotheses.rationale: The task asked for the most recent beluga whale GFF3 link as of 20/10/2020, which is hosted on Ensembl release 101. This mis-specification led the team away from the correct target (Ensembl FTP gff3 path) and ultimately to an incorrect final answer (an NCBI GDV genome viewer URL). Had the Orchestrator correctly specified going directly to Ensembl FTP releases (e.g., browsing Ensembl release directories around Oct 2020 and finding release-101 gff3/delphinapterus_leucas), the correct link would likely have been found.
